title: Emergency crews respond to restaurant fire at George Bush Intercontinental Airport's Terminal C North, airport authorities say
text:
Emergency crews respond to restaurant fire at George Bush Intercontinental Airport's Terminal C North, airport authorities say - ABC13 Houston 
 24/7 Live Houston Southwest Southeast Northwest Northeast Fire 
 Emergency crews respond to restaurant fire at IAH's Terminal C North, airport officials said 
 Watch Eyewitness News and ABC13 originals around the clock Tuesday, October 27, 2026 10:23PM Share Follow ABC13 on Google HOUSTON, Texas (KTRK) -- Emergency crews responded to a reported fire at George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) on Tuesday afternoon, according to Houston airport authorities.
 Airport officials said that Houston Fire Department crews were dispatched to a fire at a restaurant in Terminal C North of IAH.
 Authorities said that passengers in the immediate area were relocated as a precaution.
 Officials did not share how the fire began or whether anyone was injured.
 ABC13 crews are en route to gather more information on the incident.
 SkyEye13 was over the scene on Tuesday afternoon, capturing images of HFD crews responding to the reported fire. 
 ABC13 received images from the scene, depicting visible smoke from the reported airport fire.
 Tom Butt 
 This is a developing story. Eyewitness News is continuing to gather facts.
